0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003330_RAUBAHN
0.description: There have been several skirmishes along the border, but as yet, neither side has delivered a decisive blow.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003340_RAUBAHN
1.description: We had long assumed that the Garleans would overwhelm us in a straight fight, but we seem to be gaining ground, albeit slowly.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003350_RAUBAHN
2.description: As to why that might be... The most likely explanation is that they have yet to commit all their forces. Still, we're winning, and our latest intelligence suggests the Emperor has retreated back to Garlemald.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003360_RAUBAHN
3.description: In light of this, we're considering launching an offensive, with the aim of pushing the front line forward, and giving ourselves some room to breathe.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003370_PANICKEDFIGHTER
4.description: Commander! The imperials─they've broken through our defenses to the east.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003390_PANICKEDFIGHTER
6.description: Our scouts say their forces are being led by Lord Zenos!

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003400_PANICKEDFIGHTER
7.description: Lord Hien and Commander Hext have taken their troops to provide support, but we don't know how long they can hold out.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003410_RAUBAHN
8.description: So they've been biding their time, waiting for his arrival, have they?

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003420_RAUBAHN
9.description: Very well. Send word to our allies, requesting reinforcements for the front line.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003430_RAUBAHN
10.description: Should the worst come to the worst, I may need to enter the fray myself. But what of you? Do you still have the strength to fight?

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
12.description: You need only say the word.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_A6_000_002_NONE_VOICE
13.description: So long as you leave the Ascian to me.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003440_RAUBAHN
14.description: Much obliged. Given the choice, I'd take you over a hundred soldiers.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003450_RAUBAHN
15.description: He may not <hex:021A020203>die<hex:021A020103> as such, but to see Lord Zenos fall on the battlefield would deal a heavy blow to imperial morale. I'll see to it the men stay clear.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003480_RAUBAHN
18.description: What's wrong? Is it the voice again?

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003490_RAUBAHN
19.description: Are you sure you're in a fit state to do this?

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003510_RAUBAHN
21.description: Give them hell, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>. I, for my part, will defend this place to my dying breath.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003515_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
22.description: Meanwhile, at the border of Ala Mhigo...

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003590_HIEN
31.description: Magic? With a Garlean body? That's hardly fair...

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003600_HIEN
32.description: Still, he must be stopped...no matter the cost...

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003610_ROBEMAN
33.description: (-Zenos-)Ah, Bringer of Light. It has been too long.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003620_ROBEMAN
34.description: (-Zenos-)No words to mark our reunion? ...So be it.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003630_ROBEMAN
35.description: (-Zenos-)Equilibrium must be restored... And only your death will redress the balance.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003650_ROBEMAN
37.description: (-Zenos-)Yet for all your strength, you will still fail.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003710_MYSTERYVOICE
43.description: Please! There is no cause for alarm!

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003720_MYSTERYVOICE
44.description: ...Though, I confess, this is not where I had intended to meet.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003730_MYSTERYVOICE
45.description: But the place of our meeting is of no consequence─like the war you wage. Win or lose, the path you walk leads only to oblivion.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003740_MYSTERYVOICE
46.description: The better path leads you here. To me. I have need of your strength.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
49.description: You have to send me back, now!

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003750_MYSTERYVOICE
50.description: I am afraid such questions will have to wait. We have precious little time, and your work is not yet done.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003760_MYSTERYVOICE
51.description: The battle is over. The danger passed. But your work is not yet done.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003770_MYSTERYVOICE
52.description: Go to the Crystal Tower. I have left something for you near its base.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003780_MYSTERYVOICE
53.description: It will serve as a beacon of sorts. One which I pray will help you on your journey.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003790_MYSTERYVOICE
54.description: All you need do is find it. I will take care of the rest.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003800_MYSTERYVOICE
55.description: Soon we will throw wide the gates...

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003810_MYSTERYVOICE
56.description: And the path to the First will be yours to walk at last.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003830_AYMERIC
61.description: Do you recall the confrontation with Zenos? You were the first to come to the aid of Mistress Lyse and the others on the front line.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003840_AYMERIC
62.description: I see you recall that much, at least.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003850_AYMERIC
63.description: In the midst of your duel, it is said you faltered, and that the crown prince seized the opportunity to deliver a mortal blow.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003860_AYMERIC
64.description: Yet before his blade could find its mark, he was distracted by the arrival of a second adversary who bore you away from the battlefield and into the hands of our chirurgeons.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003870_AYMERIC
65.description: Lest you wonder, he left before you awoke. As is his wont.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003880_AYMERIC
66.description: Estinien never was one for emotional farewells.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003890_AYMERIC
67.description: Though Zenos bested all before him, the battle clearly took its toll, for he retreated shortly after your rescue. Seeing this, the remaining imperial forces decided discretion was the better part of valor and pulled back, allowing us to reestablish our position.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003900_AYMERIC
68.description: We have since received word of renewed unrest in the provinces, doubtless inspired by the efforts of the Eorzean Alliance and our Far Eastern allies.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003910_AYMERIC
69.description: Nor does the good news end there. We have also come into possession of intelligence suggesting unrest within the imperial court.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003920_AYMERIC
70.description: This would certainly explain why both the Emperor and Lord Zenos appear to have abandoned the fight.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003930_AYMERIC
71.description: A long-awaited ray of hope in these dark times.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003940_AYMERIC
75.description: Yet to awake, I'm afraid. But, please...concentrate on your own recovery for now.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003950_AYMERIC
76.description: You have carried the hopes of some half-dozen nations─and we are all eternally grateful for your efforts─but no one is without their limits. Not even you.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003960_AYMERIC
77.description: Leave this fight to us, my friend. You have earned your rest.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003980_AYMERIC
79.description: I was asked to deliver a message as soon as you awoke.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_003990_AYMERIC
80.description: A reminder that you are not alone, though many of your allies have fallen.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004000_AYMERIC
81.description: When you are well and rested, you are to return home, where friends will be waiting for you.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004010_AYMERIC
82.description: Now, if you will excuse me, I must return to the front. May we meet again soon. Under happier circumstances.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004020_TATARU
83.description: By the Twelve, I don't believe it!

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004040_TATARU
85.description: I rushed back as soon as I could.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004050_TATARU
86.description: I swear, my heart nearly stopped when I heard you'd collapsed like the others. What in heavens' name is going on?

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004060_TATARU
87.description: “Win or lose, the path you walk leads only to oblivion.” ...Well, that's helpful.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004070_TATARU
88.description: And what else did he say? The better path leads to him? Hmm...

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004080_TATARU
89.description: If his is the voice you've all been hearing, perhaps the others are with him.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004090_TATARU
90.description: Ser Aymeric said the fighting had reached a stalemate, didn't he.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004100_TATARU
91.description: But if that monster masquerading as Zenos comes back...

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004110_TATARU
92.description: Thancred, Y'shtola, Urianger, Alphinaud, Alisaie... You're going to need all of them on your side to defeat him.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004120_TATARU
93.description: And I forbid you from going to face him on your own. Do you hear me?

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004130_TATARU
94.description: So if you must leave... Go and find the others. Bring them home.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004140_TATARU
95.description: As for where to start, you said the stranger had left a beacon for you at the Crystal Tower, right?

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004150_TATARU
96.description: Well, it's not as if you haven't been there before...but I'm guessing “near its base” doesn't narrow things down very much.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004160_TATARU
97.description: But how are you to find it now that the tower has been sealed shut?

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004170_TATARU
98.description: But I'm sure I remember hearing that the tower was blocked off?

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004180_TATARU
99.description: There has to be a way... If anyone would know, it's Cid and the researchers of Saint Coinach's Find.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004190_TATARU
100.description: Don't you worry. We'll find that beacon for you.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004210_ROBEMAN
102.description: (-Zenos-)...I pray you have good reason for abandoning the front.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004220_VARIS
103.description: How could I remain there while the rumor that my son is possessed by a demon spreads like a sickness here at home?

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004230_VARIS
104.description: I will not be made to fight for the throne a second time.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004240_VARIS
105.description: But what of you? Did you not tell me you would destroy Eorzea's champion with the ease that one might swat a fly?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004250_ROBEMAN
106.description: (-Zenos-)A minor setback. <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> will not escape me again.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004260_ROBEMAN
107.description: (-Zenos-)Where is your grandsire? I would have words with him.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004270_VARIS
108.description: How should I know? Do you hide from each other's sight as well? I imagine he is doing what all Ascians do.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004280_ROBEMAN
109.description: (-Zenos-)Hmmm... He must have found a way to take advantage of this turmoil.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004290_VARIS
110.description: Men are not pawns to be played with, Ascian. You underestimate us at your peril.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004300_VARIS
111.description: This war will not be decided by you and yours. Man must choose his own fate, and I, for my part, will do all within my power to see Garlemald emerge victorious.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004310_IMPERIALENGINEER
112.description: Pray forgive the intrusion, Your Radiance, but the requested preparations are now complete.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004320_IMPERIALENGINEER
113.description: We stand ready to begin production of Black Rose, upon your order.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004330_KATANASOLDIER
114.description: My enemy. My friend. Had I been but a step faster...

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004360_KATANASOLDIER
117.description: A pity your hunt leads you elsewhere... Not that I am surprised.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004370_KATANASOLDIER
118.description: May you find joy in it. Grow stronger, more savage, and savor every triumph...

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04505_004380_KATANASOLDIER
119.description: In the meantime...I will reclaim that which is rightfully mine.
